description: AWS, Azure, GCP cloud infrastructure — API auditing, cost anomalies, resource drift, and security posture.
name: Cloud Infrastructure
quickFacts: Enable CloudTrail/Activity Log and use the respective Splunk TA to start collecting API audit events.

useCases.title: Unauthorized API Calls
useCases.value: AccessDenied errors reveal reconnaissance activity, compromised credentials with insufficient permissions, or misconfigurations. Early indicator of attack or drift.

useCases.title: Root Account Usage
useCases.value: The AWS root account has unrestricted access and should never be used for daily operations. Any root activity is a critical security event.

useCases.title: Security Group Changes
useCases.value: Security group changes can expose services to the internet. Unauthorized modifications are a primary attack vector and compliance violation.

useCases.title: IAM Policy Changes
useCases.value: IAM policy changes affect who can do what across the entire AWS account. Unauthorized policy attachments can grant admin access.

useCases.title: Console Login Without MFA
useCases.value: Console access without MFA is a security risk — compromised passwords alone can grant full account access. Most compliance frameworks require MFA.

useCases.title: EC2 Instance State Changes
useCases.value: Tracks instance lifecycle for audit and change management. Unexpected terminations indicate accidents, auto-scaling issues, or attacks.

useCases.title: S3 Bucket Policy Changes
useCases.value: S3 bucket policy changes can expose sensitive data to the public internet. One of the most common cloud security incidents.

useCases.title: GuardDuty Finding Ingestion
useCases.value: GuardDuty provides ML-powered threat detection for AWS accounts. Centralizing findings in Splunk enables correlation with other security data.

useCases.title: VPC Flow Log Analysis
useCases.value: VPC Flow Logs provide network-level visibility into all traffic. Detects rejected traffic, data exfiltration, lateral movement, and network anomalies.

useCases.title: EC2 Performance Monitoring
useCases.value: CloudWatch metrics provide host-level performance data without agents. Baseline trending for capacity planning and anomaly detection.

useCases.title: RDS Performance Insights
useCases.value: Database performance issues directly impact application experience. Monitoring connections, CPU, IOPS, and replica lag catches problems before users notice.

useCases.title: Lambda Error Rate Monitoring
useCases.value: Lambda errors affect serverless application reliability. Timeouts indicate functions need more memory/time. Throttling means concurrency limits are hit.

useCases.title: EKS/ECS Cluster Health
useCases.value: Unhealthy ECS/EKS control planes strand deployments and skew desired-vs-running task counts, causing user-visible errors before infrastructure metrics breach thresholds. Route platform-level failures…

useCases.title: Cost Anomaly Detection
useCases.value: Unexpected spend spikes indicate runaway resources, cryptomining attacks, or misconfigured services. Catching anomalies early saves money.

useCases.title: Config Compliance Monitoring
useCases.value: AWS Config rules continuously evaluate resource compliance against security best practices. Non-compliant resources are attack surface.

useCases.title: KMS Key Usage Audit
useCases.value: Encryption key usage audit ensures data protection compliance. Unusual key access patterns may indicate unauthorized data decryption.

useCases.title: Elastic IP Association
useCases.value: Unassociated Elastic IPs cost money. Tracking associations supports inventory accuracy and cost management.

useCases.title: CloudFormation Stack Drift
useCases.value: Drift means infrastructure no longer matches its declared template — manual changes have been made. This breaks IaC and causes inconsistencies.

useCases.title: WAF Blocked Request Analysis
useCases.value: WAF blocks reveal attack patterns targeting your applications. Analysis helps tune rules and understand the threat landscape.

useCases.title: Reserved Instance Utilization
useCases.value: Underutilized RIs waste money. Tracking RI coverage and utilization helps optimize commit spending vs. on-demand costs.

useCases.title: ALB/NLB Access Logs and 5xx Errors
useCases.value: Load balancer 5xx and target failures indicate backend or LB misconfiguration. Access logs enable traffic analysis and security forensics.

useCases.title: ELB Target Health and Unhealthy Hosts
useCases.value: Unhealthy targets cause traffic to fail or shift to remaining nodes. Early detection prevents user-facing outages.

useCases.title: CloudFront Cache Hit Ratio and Origin Errors
useCases.value: Low cache hit ratio increases origin load and latency. Origin errors indicate backend or CDN misconfiguration.

useCases.title: SQS Queue Depth and Age of Oldest Message
useCases.value: Growing queue depth or old messages indicate consumers are falling behind or failing. Prevents backlog and SLA breaches.

useCases.title: SQS Dead-Letter Queue Message Count
useCases.value: Messages in DLQ indicate processing failures. Immediate alerting ensures failed messages are investigated and reprocessed.

useCases.title: DynamoDB Throttled Requests and Consumed Capacity
useCases.value: Throttling causes request failures and degraded application performance. Capacity monitoring supports right-sizing and auto-scaling.

useCases.title: API Gateway 4xx/5xx and Throttling
useCases.value: High 4xx/5xx or throttling indicates misconfigured APIs, backend failures, or abuse. Essential for API reliability and quota management.

useCases.title: EBS Volume Status and Burst Balance
useCases.value: EBS status checks and burst balance (gp2/gp3) indicate volume health and risk of I/O throttling when credits are exhausted.

useCases.title: EC2 Spot Instance Interruption Notices
useCases.value: Spot interruptions cause instance termination with short notice. Tracking enables graceful shutdown, workload migration, and capacity planning.

useCases.title: CloudTrail Log File Delivery Failures
useCases.value: Failed CloudTrail delivery means audit gaps. Attackers may target trail deletion or S3 permissions to hide activity.

useCases.title: CloudWatch Alarm State Changes
useCases.value: Alarm state transitions (OK → ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA) provide a consolidated view of metric-based issues. Centralizing in Splunk enables correlation with other data.

useCases.title: NAT Gateway Bytes Processed and Connection Tracking
useCases.value: NAT Gateway is a single point of egress for private subnets. Monitoring bytes and connection count supports capacity and cost (data processed) planning.

useCases.title: VPN Connection State and Tunnel Status
useCases.value: VPN down breaks hybrid connectivity. Tunnel state monitoring ensures quick detection and failover to secondary tunnel or connection.

useCases.title: AWS Organizations SCP and OU Changes
useCases.value: SCP (Service Control Policy) and OU structure changes affect permissions across many accounts. Unauthorized changes can weaken security boundaries.

useCases.title: S3 Replication Lag and Failed Replication
useCases.value: Replication lag or failures break DR and compliance. Detecting failures ensures data is replicated within RPO.

useCases.title: ElastiCache/Redis CPU and Evictions
useCases.value: High CPU or evictions indicate undersized cache or hot keys. Impacts application latency and cache hit ratio.

useCases.title: SNS Delivery Failures and Bounce/Complaint
useCases.value: SNS delivery failures mean subscribers are not receiving notifications. Bounce/complaint (for email) affects sender reputation and deliverability.

useCases.title: EventBridge Rule Invocation and Failed Invocations
useCases.value: Failed invocations mean downstream targets (Lambda, SQS, etc.) are not receiving events. Critical for event-driven architecture reliability.

useCases.title: AWS Backup Restore Job Failures
useCases.value: Restore job failures prevent recovery during DR. Monitoring ensures backup and restore pipeline is healthy.

useCases.title: Route 53 Health Check Failures
useCases.value: Health check failures indicate endpoint or path unreachable. Used for failover and monitoring of external/internal resources.

useCases.title: Redshift Cluster Health and Connection Count
useCases.value: Redshift cluster health and connection exhaustion impact analytics workloads. Monitoring supports capacity and connection limit management.

useCases.title: Step Functions Execution Failures
useCases.value: Failed or aborted executions break workflows. Tracking failure rate and failed execution IDs enables debugging and retry.

useCases.title: EFS Burst Credit Balance and Throughput
useCases.value: EFS burst credits deplete under sustained high throughput; performance then drops to baseline. Monitoring prevents unexpected slowdowns.

useCases.title: Inspector Vulnerability and Finding Trends
useCases.value: Inspector findings (EC2, ECR, Lambda) identify vulnerabilities. Tracking trends and new critical findings supports patch and image hygiene.

useCases.title: Systems Manager (SSM) Patch Compliance
useCases.value: Low patch compliance increases vulnerability. SSM Patch Manager compliance status enables prioritization and remediation tracking.

useCases.title: Direct Connect Virtual Interface BGP State
useCases.value: BGP down on Direct Connect breaks hybrid connectivity. Monitoring BGP session state ensures quick detection and carrier escalation.

useCases.title: Glue Job Run Failures and Duration
useCases.value: Glue job failures break ETL pipelines. Duration trends support capacity and cost optimization.

useCases.title: Athena Query Execution Failures and Bytes Scanned
useCases.value: Failed queries and high bytes scanned impact user experience and cost. Monitoring supports optimization and error triage.

useCases.title: FSx for Lustre/Windows Capacity and Throughput
useCases.value: FSx capacity and throughput metrics support HPC and Windows file share capacity planning and performance troubleshooting.

useCases.title: Trusted Advisor Check Results and Cost Optimization
useCases.value: Trusted Advisor identifies cost optimization, performance, and security improvements. Tracking check results supports governance and savings.

useCases.title: Lambda Concurrent Executions and Throttling
useCases.value: Throttling occurs when concurrent executions hit account or function limits. Monitoring prevents dropped invocations and supports quota increase requests.

useCases.title: ECR Image Scan Findings
useCases.value: ECR image scan finds CVEs in container images. Critical/high findings in production images require immediate remediation or rollback.

useCases.title: CloudWatch Logs Subscription Filter Errors
useCases.value: Subscription filter delivery failures mean logs are not reaching Lambda, Kinesis, or Firehose. Indicates quota, permission, or downstream failures.

useCases.title: Kinesis Data Stream Iterator Age and Throttling
useCases.value: High iterator age means consumers are falling behind. Throttling indicates producers exceed shard capacity. Both cause lag and potential data loss.

useCases.title: Secrets Manager Secret Rotation and Access
useCases.value: Failed rotation leaves stale credentials. Unusual access patterns may indicate credential abuse. Audit supports compliance and incident response.

useCases.title: AWS Lambda Cold Start Monitoring
useCases.value: Cold start frequency and duration impact user experience. High cold start rates or long init times cause request latency spikes and timeouts.

useCases.title: AWS ECS Task Placement Failures
useCases.value: Tasks failing to place due to resource constraints (CPU, memory, ports, attributes) cause service scaling failures and deployment blockages.

useCases.title: AWS Transit Gateway Attachment Health
useCases.value: TGW route propagation and attachment state affect cross-VPC and hybrid connectivity. Failed attachments or stale routes cause network outages.

useCases.title: S3 Suspicious Access Patterns
useCases.value: Unusual ListBucket volume, access from new regions, or anonymous reads often precede data exfiltration; pattern detection reduces dwell time.

useCases.title: Security Hub Alert Aggregation
useCases.value: Security Hub rolls up Config, GuardDuty, Inspector, and partner findings; aggregating by account and severity prioritizes remediation queues.

useCases.title: Network ACL Changes
useCases.value: NACL changes can open subnets to the internet or break least-privilege segmentation; they are less common than security groups and warrant explicit audit.

useCases.title: RDS Performance Insights Trending
useCases.value: Performance Insights exposes DB load by wait state; trending top SQL and waits guides index and instance right-sizing beyond raw CPU.

useCases.title: ECS Service Health
useCases.value: Service-level running count versus desired indicates deployment failures, capacity shortfall, or health check flapping.

useCases.title: EKS Control Plane Audit
useCases.value: Kubernetes audit logs capture who changed roles, secrets, and workloads; essential for forensics and SOC2 evidence on EKS.

useCases.title: GuardDuty Severity Analysis
useCases.value: Prioritizing GuardDuty findings by severity and type reduces noise and speeds triage versus raw event volume.

useCases.title: AWS Config Rule Compliance Drift
useCases.value: Resources oscillating between COMPLIANT and NON_COMPLIANT indicate automation fights or manual changes—drift trends surface systemic issues.

useCases.title: SNS Delivery Failures
useCases.value: Failed SMS, email, or HTTP subscriptions break alerting and fan-out; monitoring delivery failures prevents silent notification loss.

useCases.title: SQS Dead Letter Queue Growth
useCases.value: DLQ depth growth means poison messages or downstream outages; rate-of-change highlights incidents faster than static thresholds.

useCases.title: CloudFront Error Rates by Distribution
useCases.value: Origin or edge errors vary by distribution; breaking out 4xx/5xx by `DistributionId` isolates bad releases and misconfigured behaviors.

useCases.title: Route 53 Health Check Failover Validation
useCases.value: Failed health checks drive DNS failover; sustained failures mean user-facing outages or flapping routing policies.

useCases.title: Systems Manager Patch Compliance
useCases.value: Patch baselines reduce exploit exposure; instance-level compliance gaps show outdated AMIs or broken agents.

useCases.title: Transit Gateway Route Table Attachment Health
useCases.value: Beyond attachment state, route propagation to TGW route tables determines reachability; blackholes show as dropped traffic or failed tests.

useCases.title: ELB Target Health Check Failures
useCases.value: Unhealthy targets are removed from rotation; rising unhealthy counts precede customer-facing errors.

useCases.title: IAM Access Analyzer Findings
useCases.value: Access Analyzer identifies unintended external access to S3, IAM roles, KMS keys, and other resources—reducing public exposure risk.

useCases.title: AWS Backup Job Status
useCases.value: Centralized backup vault jobs must complete on schedule; failed jobs leave RPO gaps across EC2, EFS, and databases.

useCases.title: Lambda Layer Version Compliance
useCases.value: Outdated layers carry vulnerable dependencies; enforcing approved layer ARNs avoids shadow IT libraries in functions.

useCases.title: AWS Fargate Task Health
useCases.value: Fargate tasks are the unit of scale; tracking stopped tasks and resource limits surfaces platform issues before services miss SLAs.

useCases.title: Azure Activity Log Monitoring
useCases.value: Activity Log captures all control plane operations across Azure subscriptions. Essential audit trail for resource management and compliance.

useCases.title: Entra ID Sign-In Anomalies
useCases.value: Risky sign-ins include impossible travel, unfamiliar locations, and anonymous IP usage. Primary detection layer for account compromise.

useCases.title: Entra ID Privilege Escalation
useCases.value: Privileged role assignments (Global Admin, Privileged Role Admin) grant extreme power. Unauthorized assignments mean full tenant compromise.

useCases.title: NSG Flow Log Analysis
useCases.value: NSG Flow Logs provide Azure network-level visibility. Detects blocked traffic, anomalous patterns, and lateral movement within VNets.

useCases.title: Azure VM Performance
useCases.value: Azure Monitor metrics provide VM performance data without agents. Essential for capacity planning and correlating with application issues.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Performance
useCases.value: DTU/vCore exhaustion causes query throttling. Deadlocks and long-running queries impact application performance directly.

useCases.title: AKS Cluster Health
useCases.value: AKS cluster health monitoring ensures Kubernetes workloads are running reliably on Azure's managed platform.

useCases.title: Azure Key Vault Access Audit
useCases.value: Key Vault stores secrets, keys, and certificates. Unauthorized or anomalous access could indicate credential theft or data breach preparation.

useCases.title: Defender for Cloud Alerts
useCases.value: Microsoft Defender provides threat detection across Azure resources. Centralizing in Splunk enables cross-platform security correlation.

useCases.title: Storage Account Access Anomalies
useCases.value: Unusual storage access patterns may indicate data exfiltration or compromised service principals accessing sensitive data.

useCases.title: Resource Health Events
useCases.value: Azure service health impacts your resources directly. Knowing when Azure itself is having problems prevents wasted troubleshooting time.

useCases.title: Cost Management Alerts
useCases.value: Azure cost monitoring prevents budget overruns. Tracking spend by resource group/team enables chargeback and anomaly detection.

useCases.title: App Service (Web App) HTTP 5xx and Slot Swap
useCases.value: App Service 5xx and failed slot swaps impact user experience and deployment safety. Monitoring supports reliability and blue-green deployment.

useCases.title: Azure Load Balancer Health Probe Failures
useCases.value: Probe failures mean backends are unhealthy; traffic stops flowing to those instances. Critical for load balancer and application availability.

useCases.title: Azure Backup Job Failures
useCases.value: Backup job failures break recovery guarantees. Detecting failures ensures backups are fixed before they are needed for restore.

useCases.title: Logic Apps Run Failures
useCases.value: Logic App run failures break automation and integrations. Tracking failures and retries supports debugging and SLA.

useCases.title: Service Bus Queue Message Count and Dead Letter
useCases.value: Growing queue or dead-letter count indicates consumers falling behind or message processing failures. Prevents backlog and lost messages.

useCases.title: Cosmos DB RU Consumption and Throttling
useCases.value: Throttling (429) occurs when RU consumption exceeds provisioned throughput. Monitoring supports right-sizing and autoscale tuning.

useCases.title: Azure Front Door / CDN Origin Errors and Cache Hit
useCases.value: Origin errors and low cache hit ratio impact latency and origin load. Essential for CDN and global app performance.

useCases.title: Event Grid Delivery Failures
useCases.value: Delivery failures mean subscribers did not receive events. Critical for event-driven architecture and integration reliability.

useCases.title: Azure Container Registry Pull/Push and Vulnerability Scan
useCases.value: ACR stores container images. Unusual pull/push or image scan findings indicate abuse or vulnerable images in use.

useCases.title: Azure Firewall Rule Hit and Threat Intel
useCases.value: Firewall logs show allowed/denied traffic and threat intelligence hits. Essential for network security and incident response.

useCases.title: Azure Database for MySQL/PostgreSQL Metrics
useCases.value: Managed MySQL/PostgreSQL CPU, storage, and connection metrics support capacity and performance management beyond Azure SQL.

useCases.title: Azure Monitor Alert State Changes
useCases.value: Alert state changes (fired, resolved) provide consolidated view of metric/log conditions. Centralizing in Splunk enables correlation.

useCases.title: Entra ID Conditional Access Blocked Sign-Ins
useCases.value: Blocked sign-ins by Conditional Access indicate policy enforcement. Tracking blocks helps tune policies and detect bypass attempts.

useCases.title: Azure Service Health and Planned Maintenance
useCases.value: Service Health and planned maintenance notifications prevent wasted troubleshooting and enable change planning.

useCases.title: Azure Policy Compliance and Non-Compliant Resources
useCases.value: Azure Policy enforces governance. Non-compliant resources increase risk and compliance gaps. Tracking compliance supports remediation.

useCases.title: Azure App Service Plan CPU and Memory
useCases.value: Platform-level resource pressure on App Service plan (not app-level) causes throttling, slow responses, and out-of-memory errors across all apps in the plan.

useCases.title: Azure Front Door Origin Health
useCases.value: Origin probe failures cause automatic failover. Repeated failures indicate backend issues or misconfigured health probes; critical for global load balancing and CDN reliability.

useCases.title: NSG Flow Log Threat Hunting
useCases.value: NSG flow logs reveal lateral movement, denied probes, and unexpected east-west volume; baselining flows speeds incident triage beyond simple allow/deny counts.

useCases.title: Azure Policy Compliance Trending
useCases.value: Point-in-time compliance misses drift; trending non-compliant resource counts shows whether governance keeps pace with deployments.

useCases.title: Key Vault Access Audit
useCases.value: Secret and key unwrap operations must be traceable for insider and breach investigations; unusual callers warrant immediate review.

useCases.title: App Service Health Metrics
useCases.value: HTTP queue length, response time, and instance health explain user-visible slowness before 5xx rates spike.

useCases.title: AKS Diagnostics and Errors
useCases.value: Control plane and node problems surface as API errors, failed mounts, and ImagePullBackOff; centralized errors shorten MTTR.

useCases.title: Cost Management Anomaly Detection
useCases.value: Built-in Cost Management alerts help, but statistical baselines on daily spend catch unusual service charges early.

useCases.title: Azure Firewall Threat Intelligence Hits
useCases.value: Threat intel–based denies block known-bad IPs and domains at the edge; volume and target trends indicate active campaigns or misclassified traffic.

useCases.title: Front Door WAF Blocks
useCases.value: Managed rule blocks protect origins; tracking rule IDs separates scanning noise from targeted application abuse.

useCases.title: Logic App Run Failures
useCases.value: Integration workflows power automation; failed runs leave tickets, data, and approvals stuck.

useCases.title: Event Hub Capture Lag
useCases.value: Capture to ADLS/Blob enables batch analytics; lag between enqueue and file availability delays downstream pipelines.

useCases.title: Azure Backup Job Health
useCases.value: Failed or missed backup jobs leave restore gaps; operational health must be tracked per protected item.

useCases.title: Private Link DNS Resolution
useCases.value: Private Endpoint FQDNs resolve via private DNS zones; NXDOMAIN or public resolution leaks traffic or breaks apps.

useCases.title: Azure Monitor Alert Rule Health
useCases.value: Disabled or misconfigured alert rules create silent monitoring gaps; tracking rule state protects on-call coverage.

useCases.title: Defender for Cloud Recommendations
useCases.value: Secure score and recommendations drive hardening backlog; trending open recommendations shows risk posture over time.

useCases.title: Azure Resource Lock Changes
useCases.value: Locks prevent accidental deletes; removing a lock before maintenance is high risk and must be audited.

useCases.title: Azure Container Instances Health
useCases.value: ACI containers are short-lived and opaque without platform metrics; monitoring restarts and resource exhaustion preserves burst workloads and integrations.

useCases.title: Azure Application Gateway and WAF Health
useCases.value: Application Gateway is the primary L7 load balancer for most Azure web workloads. Backend health probe failures cause 502 errors for users; WAF blocks need tuning to avoid false positives.

useCases.title: Azure VPN Gateway Tunnel Status
useCases.value: VPN gateway tunnel drops break hybrid connectivity between Azure and on-premises networks. Nearly every enterprise Azure customer relies on site-to-site VPN; tunnel status is a fundamental availabili…

useCases.title: Azure ExpressRoute Circuit Health
useCases.value: ExpressRoute provides dedicated private connectivity to Azure for large enterprises. Circuit degradation or BGP peer loss causes failover to backup paths or complete connectivity loss to Azure servic…

useCases.title: Azure Redis Cache Performance
useCases.value: Redis Cache is a common caching and session store layer in Azure architectures. High server load, memory pressure, or cache misses directly impact application response times.

useCases.title: Azure Data Factory Pipeline Failures
useCases.value: Data Factory orchestrates ETL/ELT pipelines that feed data warehouses, analytics, and operational systems. Pipeline failures cause stale data, broken dashboards, and missed SLAs.

useCases.title: Azure API Management (APIM) Health
useCases.value: APIM is the gateway for API-first architectures. Backend errors, high latency, and rate limit breaches directly impact API consumers and downstream applications.

useCases.title: Azure Virtual Desktop Session Health
useCases.value: Azure Virtual Desktop provides remote desktop infrastructure. Connection failures, high round-trip latency, and session drops directly impact end-user productivity.

useCases.title: Azure Traffic Manager Endpoint Health
useCases.value: Traffic Manager provides DNS-based global load balancing. Degraded endpoints cause traffic to shift, but undetected health changes can leave users routed to unhealthy regions.

useCases.title: Azure Bastion Session Audit
useCases.value: Bastion provides secure, auditable VM access without public IPs. Monitoring session activity ensures compliance with access policies and detects unauthorized connection attempts.

useCases.title: Azure Network Watcher Connection Troubleshooting
useCases.value: Network Watcher captures flow logs, connection monitors, and packet captures for Azure networks. Proactive monitoring of connectivity test results detects network issues before they impact applicatio…

useCases.title: Azure Storage Queue Depth and Poison Messages
useCases.value: Storage Queues decouple application components. Growing queue depth indicates consumers cannot keep up; poison messages in the poison queue represent permanently failed processing that needs attentio…

useCases.value: Azure managed disks have IOPS and throughput caps based on tier and size. When VMs hit these limits, disk I/O is throttled, causing application slowdowns that are hard to diagnose without platform me…

useCases.title: Audit Log Monitoring
useCases.value: GCP audit logs capture all admin activity and data access. Foundational for security monitoring and compliance in GCP environments.

useCases.title: IAM Policy Changes
useCases.value: IAM binding changes control who can access what in GCP. Unauthorized changes to bindings on projects, folders, or organizations are critical security events.

useCases.title: VPC Flow Log Analysis
useCases.value: GCP VPC Flow Logs provide network traffic visibility. Same use case as AWS/Azure — detect rejected traffic, anomalies, exfiltration.

useCases.title: GKE Cluster Health
useCases.value: GKE cluster health monitoring for managed Kubernetes in GCP. Node pools, upgrade status, and workload health.

useCases.title: Security Command Center
useCases.value: SCC provides vulnerability findings and threat detections across GCP. Centralizing in Splunk enables multi-cloud security correlation.

useCases.title: GCE Instance Monitoring
useCases.value: Compute Engine VM performance monitoring for capacity planning and baseline trending without guest-level agents.

useCases.title: BigQuery Audit and Cost
useCases.value: BigQuery can generate massive costs from poorly optimized queries. Audit and cost tracking prevents bill shock and identifies optimization opportunities.

useCases.title: Cloud Run/Functions Errors
useCases.value: Serverless function errors and cold starts impact application reliability and user experience.

useCases.title: Cloud Load Balancing Backend Health and Request Count
useCases.value: Unhealthy backends receive no traffic; request count and latency indicate load and performance. Essential for global and regional LB reliability.

useCases.title: Cloud Pub/Sub Subscription Backlog and Dead Letter
useCases.value: Backlog (unacked messages) and dead-letter count indicate consumers falling behind or failing. Prevents message loss and SLA breach.

useCases.title: Cloud Storage (GCS) Request Metrics and Cost
useCases.value: GCS request count and latency support performance tuning. Cost tracking by bucket/class prevents bill shock.

useCases.title: Cloud SQL Instance Metrics and Replication Lag
useCases.value: Cloud SQL CPU, storage, and replication lag impact application performance and DR. Monitoring supports capacity and replica health.

useCases.title: Cloud Build Build Failures and Duration
useCases.value: Build failures block deployments. Duration trends support pipeline optimization and quota management.

useCases.title: GKE Node Pool Autoscaling and Upgrade Events
useCases.value: Node pool scale-up/down and upgrade events affect workload placement and availability. Monitoring supports capacity and upgrade windows.

useCases.title: Cloud CDN Cache Hit Ratio and Egress
useCases.value: Cache hit ratio and egress volume impact latency and cost. Low hit ratio increases origin load and egress charges.

useCases.title: Artifact Registry Push/Pull and Vulnerability Scan
useCases.value: Unusual push/pull may indicate abuse. Vulnerability scan findings in images require remediation before deployment.

useCases.title: Cloud Logging Export Sink and Exclusion Filter
useCases.value: Log sink and exclusion changes affect what is exported to Splunk or other destinations. Unauthorized changes create visibility gaps.

useCases.title: Cloud IAM Policy and Binding Changes (Beyond SetIamPolicy)
useCases.value: IAM policy and custom role changes affect who can access resources. Broader than SetIamPolicy — includes role create/delete and org policy.

useCases.title: Cloud Billing Budget Alerts and Anomaly
useCases.value: Budget alerts and spend anomalies prevent cost overruns. Early detection enables corrective action before invoice.

useCases.title: Cloud Armor Security Policy and DDoS Metrics
useCases.value: Cloud Armor blocks and DDoS metrics indicate attack traffic and policy effectiveness. Essential for WAF and DDoS visibility.

useCases.title: Cloud Run Revision Traffic and Error Rate
useCases.value: Cloud Run revision traffic and errors indicate service health. Supports canary and blue-green deployment monitoring.

useCases.title: Dataproc Cluster and Job Failures
useCases.value: Dataproc cluster and job failures break data pipelines. Monitoring supports reliability and cost (preemptible) optimization.

useCases.title: VPC Service Controls Perimeter Violations
useCases.value: VPC Service Controls enforce network perimeter. Violations indicate data exfiltration attempts or misconfigured access. Critical for data perimeter security.

useCases.title: GCP Cloud Run Cold Start Rate
useCases.value: Serverless cold start impact on request latency. High cold start rates cause P99 latency spikes and timeouts for scale-to-zero services.

useCases.title: BigQuery Slot Usage Monitoring
useCases.value: Slot contention slows queries and raises cost; tracking slot usage versus reservation prevents interactive BI outages and runaway batch jobs.

useCases.title: GKE Autopilot Pod Scaling
useCases.value: Autopilot scales node pools automatically; failed scale-outs leave pods pending and degrade SLOs.

useCases.title: Cloud Armor WAF Events
useCases.value: WAF blocks indicate attack traffic or misrules; separating noise from targeted campaigns protects edge apps behind HTTPS load balancers.

useCases.title: VPC Service Controls Violations
useCases.value: Real-time violation tracking complements perimeter design reviews and catches data exfiltration paths early.

useCases.title: Pub/Sub Subscription Backlog
useCases.value: Growing backlog signals consumer lag or under-provisioned workers; oldest-unacked age breaches processing SLAs.

useCases.title: Security Command Center Findings
useCases.value: SCC aggregates misconfigurations and threats; operationalizing findings closes gaps faster than periodic console reviews.

useCases.title: Cloud KMS Key Rotation Compliance
useCases.value: Crypto policy often mandates rotation; tracking next rotation time avoids audit findings and forced emergency rotations.

useCases.title: Cloud Logging Sink Health
useCases.value: Broken sinks drop audit and security logs silently; monitoring export errors preserves compliance and detection coverage.

useCases.title: GKE Node Auto-Repair Events
useCases.value: Auto-repair replaces unhealthy nodes; frequent repairs indicate image, disk, or hardware issues affecting workload stability.

useCases.title: Dataflow Pipeline Health
useCases.value: Batch and streaming pipelines power analytics; failed jobs or high system lag delay downstream consumers.

useCases.title: Cloud SQL Connection Limits
useCases.value: Hitting max connections causes application errors; trending connections versus tier limits guides pool sizing and read replicas.

useCases.title: GCS Bucket Policy Changes

useCases.title: Anthos Service Mesh Health

useCases.title: GCP Cloud Run Task Health

useCases.title: Terraform Drift Detection

useCases.title: Cross-Cloud Identity Correlation

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Cost Dashboard

useCases.title: Cloud Resource Tagging Compliance

useCases.title: Cloud Resource Inventory and Drift Summary

useCases.title: Reserved Capacity and Savings Plan Utilization (Multi-Cloud)
useCases.value: AWS RIs/SPs, Azure Reservations, and GCP Committed Use discounts reduce cost when utilized. Low utilization wastes commitment spend.

useCases.title: Cloud API Rate Limit and Throttling (429) Trends
useCases.value: 429 (Too Many Requests) from cloud APIs indicate client or provider throttling. Tracking trends supports quota increase and architecture changes.

useCases.title: Cloud Encryption and Key Rotation Compliance
useCases.value: Unencrypted resources or keys past rotation date violate compliance. Central view across clouds supports audit and remediation.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Identity and Access Anomalies
useCases.value: Correlating identity activity across AWS IAM, Entra ID, and GCP IAM detects cross-cloud abuse and compromised identities.

useCases.title: Cloud Provider Status and Incident Correlation
useCases.value: When AWS/Azure/GCP have outages, correlating provider status with your alerts prevents wasted troubleshooting and supports customer communication.

useCases.title: Cloud Trail and Diagnostic Logging Gaps

useCases.title: Cloud Resource Tag Compliance and Drift

useCases.title: Cross-Region Replication and Backup Verification

useCases.title: Cloud Quota and Service Limit Utilization

useCases.title: Cloud Endpoint and DNS Resolution Health
useCases.value: PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and private DNS zones enable secure access to AWS/Azure/GCP services. Endpoint or DNS failures cause application outages that are hard to diagnose.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Cost Anomaly and Spike Detection
useCases.value: Sudden cost spikes across AWS, Azure, or GCP indicate misconfiguration, abuse, or runaway resources. Early detection limits financial impact and supports FinOps review.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud DNS Resolution Latency
useCases.value: Cross-provider DNS query performance comparison. Slow or failed resolution causes application timeouts and user experience degradation.

useCases.title: Cloud Resource Tag Coverage Trending
useCases.value: Untagged or improperly tagged resources impact cost allocation, governance, and security. Compliance gaps block chargeback and policy enforcement.

useCases.title: Cross-Cloud Identity Federation Monitoring
useCases.value: Federation misconfiguration or token abuse spans IdPs and cloud consoles; unified visibility reduces blind spots for lateral movement across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud DNS Resolution Health
useCases.value: DNS failures in one cloud or resolver path strand hybrid apps; proactive health checks catch resolver outages and split-horizon misconfiguration before user impact.

useCases.title: Hybrid Connectivity Status
useCases.value: ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, VPN, and Interconnect carry production traffic; tunnel or BGP drops partition workloads between on-prem and cloud.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Secret Management Audit

useCases.title: Cross-Cloud Resource Tagging Compliance
useCases.value: A single tagging schema across clouds enables chargeback and policy automation; drift in one provider breaks consolidated FinOps views.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Egress Cost Comparison
useCases.value: Egress drives surprise bills; comparing outbound spend by provider and region guides data locality and CDN decisions.

useCases.title: Hybrid Identity Synchronization Health
useCases.value: AD Connect, Cloud Identity, and similar sync failures leave cloud groups stale, breaking access and compliance.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Backup Recovery Testing
useCases.value: Untested restores fail when needed; tracking drill outcomes across AWS Backup, Azure Backup, and GCP proves RPO/RTO.

useCases.title: Cloud Provider API Rate Limit Monitoring
useCases.value: Automation hitting AWS throttling, Azure 429s, or GCP RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED breaks pipelines; trending limits prevents silent job loss.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Certificate Expiry Tracking

useCases.value: Failed Lambda invocations surface runtime bugs, dependency outages, and misconfiguration before they silently drop user traffic or break downstream workflows.

useCases.title: Lambda Concurrent Execution Limits and Throttling
useCases.value: Account- and function-level concurrency caps cause synchronous throttles and async retries; monitoring utilization prevents dropped work during traffic spikes.

useCases.value: Host startup failures, platform updates, and worker crashes take entire function apps offline; early detection reduces MTTR for serverless workloads on Azure.

useCases.title: Azure Functions Execution Duration

useCases.value: Queue-triggered functions depend on storage or Service Bus depth; growing backlogs mean consumers cannot keep pace or messages are poisoned.

useCases.title: GCP Cloud Functions Memory Utilization
useCases.value: Memory pressure causes OOM terminations and retries; tracking user memory against allocation prevents instability and guides memory settings per function.

useCases.title: GCP Cloud Functions Timeout Monitoring
useCases.value: Timeouts indicate hung dependencies or insufficient deadline; they drive retries, duplicate side effects, and user-visible failures in synchronous invocations.

useCases.title: Serverless Cost Tracking by Function
useCases.value: Function-level spend exposes expensive handlers, mis-scaled concurrency, and test sandboxes left running—essential for FinOps and chargeback.

useCases.value: Messages landing in DLQs mean unprocessed events—often billing, inventory, or security actions—until replayed or dropped.

useCases.value: Durable orchestrations span many activities; failed or stuck instances block business workflows until replayed or purged from storage.
